title: Extensionality on measurable sets proves associativity of the Giry monad (giry_joinA)
intent: Reduce the associativity law of the Giry monad, an equality of two subprobability measures, to a pointwise equality on each measurable set A, then discharge each side with the two integral lemmas giry_int_map and giry_int_join, closing the side conditions with measurable_giry_ev.

parent.name: giry_joinA
parent.statement:
Lemma giry_joinA (x : giry (giry (giry T1 R) R) R) :
  (giry_join \o giry_map measurable_giry_join) x ≡μ
  (giry_join \o giry_join) x.

children.name: giry_int_map
children.statement:
Lemma giry_int_map (mu : giry T1 R) (h : T2 -> \bar R) :
  measurable_fun [set: T2] h -> (forall x, 0 <= h x) ->
  giry_int (giry_map mf mu) h = giry_int mu (h \o f).
children.closed_by: by move=> mh h0; exact: ge0_integral_pushforward.

children.name: giry_int_join
children.statement:
Lemma giry_int_join (M : giry (giry T R) R) (h : T -> \bar R) :
    measurable_fun [set: T] h -> (forall x, 0 <= h x) ->
  giry_int (giry_join M) h = giry_int M (giry_int ^~ h).
children.closed_by: a transitivity chain through monotone_convergence and eq_integral, using sintegral_giry_join and measurable_giry_int; Qed

children.name: measurable_giry_ev
children.statement:
Lemma measurable_giry_ev (A : set T) : measurable A ->
  measurable_fun [set: giry] (giry_ev ^~ A).

applicability.goal_shape: An equality of two measures m1 = m2 where equality is pointwise on measurable sets (here the notation ≡μ, the definition measure_eq: forall S, measurable S -> m1 S = m2 S); the two sides are built from the same combinator (a Giry-monad operation) applied to different nesting.
applicability.use_when: the measures' equality is defined extensionally (measure_eq) and the two sides differ only in how a monadic operation is nested, so that one generic measurable set A reduces each side to the same integral, provable by an already-established integral-pushforward or integral-join lemma.
applicability.avoid_when: the equality is not pointwise-on-measurable-sets, the two sides need different rewrites per A, or the integral lemmas (giry_int_map, giry_int_join) are not already proved; then the extensionality step leaves a hard goal that must be split further.

consequences: The extensionality step introduces one generic measurable set A with the obligation mA : measurable A, discharged by the side-condition lemmas measurable_giry_ev and by the hypotheses (forall x, 0 <= h x) of giry_int_map and giry_int_join. It relies on the equality being measure_eq (pointwise on measurable sets); if the equality were a different relation, move=> A mA would not reduce it. The whole proof rests on the two integral lemmas already being proved: without them the pointwise goal is not a leaf.
